svg.title: VEX art pipeline: PNG strips to generated headers to banded SPI writes
svg.desc: Artists edit PNG sprite strips, a JSON manifest and a theme in art/. The importer validates them and writes five C++ headers. The shared renderer draws a 240 by 240 frame on a 100 millisecond cadence and the Teensy sends only the rows that changed.
svg.text: PEDALPARTNER / VEX ART PIPELINE / ACTUAL REPOSITORY DATA
Draw a PNG. The importer makes the headers. The renderer sends only what changed.

g.text: Pixel editors save PNG strips; frames must use
theme colours only, with alpha 0 or 255.
strip 32 x frames; theme colours; alpha 0 / 255;
strum.png frame 2 (9,14): #FF00FF not a theme colour
25 frames x 1 KB, palette index per pixel
make test fails when a committed header no longer
03 Render, then send only changed rows
240 rows x 480 B, memcmp per row, dirty rows merge
Importer step cost: blink 2.4 KB, strum step 28.8 KB, breath 26.4 KB.
Bench: flush_us and tx_bytes telemetry; Device tab mirrors the panel.

svg.text: Sources: art/, tools/make_sprites.py, firmware/VEX_Pocket_Rival/{ui.h, flush.h, link.h}, tests/core_tests.cpp. Bytes: host prediction; bench: flush_us.
